name: agentbrain
description: Shared Markdown context for one task that several agents can read and update, through the Agent Brain MCP server, with a skill that teaches agents how to use it well.

interface.longDescription: Agent Brain holds the context of one task as a small set of Markdown documents (Overview, Decisions, Findings, Handover) that different agents can read and update, even on different models or machines. Paste an agentBrain: reference into a conversation and the agent reads the index and only the documents it needs. Writes are revision-checked so agents never overwrite each other. It is not a task manager: it carries context, not assignments.
defaultPrompt: Start an Agent Brain for this task and write what we know so far.
Pick up the agentBrain: reference I paste and summarise where things stand.
